import ast

import yaml

BUILD = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = BUILD.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(BUILD))

import check_frontmatter as cf  # noqa: E402
import check_provenance as cp  # noqa: E402

SKILLS = REPO / "skills"
ALL_SKILLS = sorted(p.name for p in SKILLS.iterdir() if (p / "SKILL.md").is_file())
FALLBACK = ("Without uv, run the same path with `python3` in an environment "
            "that has the dependencies listed in the script's header.")


def frontmatter(skill_md: Path) -> dict:
    text = skill_md.read_text()
    _, fm, _ = text.split("---", 2)
    return yaml.safe_load(fm) or {}


def body_lines(skill_md: Path) -> int:
    text = skill_md.read_text()
    m = re.match(r"---\n.*?\n---\n", text, re.S)
    return len(text[m.end():].splitlines())


def make_skill(tmp_path: Path, name: str, fm: dict, body: str = "Body.\n") -> Path:
    d = tmp_path / "skills" / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / "SKILL.md").write_text("---\n" + yaml.safe_dump(fm, sort_keys=False) + "---\n" + body)
    return d


def base_fm(name: str = "demo", **extra) -> dict:
    fm = {"name": name, "description": "Use when testing.", "license": "MIT"}
    fm.update(extra)
    return fm


def write_script(skill_dir: Path, filename: str, source: str) -> Path:
    s = skill_dir / "scripts"
    s.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = s / filename
    p.write_text(source)
    return p


HEADER_STDLIB = (
    "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
    "# /// script\n"
    "# requires-python = '>=3.11'\n"
    "# dependencies = []\n"
    "# ///\n"
)

MAIN = "\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    pass\n"


def invoked_scripts(skill_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
    out = []
    for _md, _runner, path in cf.bundled_invocations(skill_dir):
        r = cf.resolve_bundled_script(path, skill_dir)
        if r is not None:
            out.append(r)
    return out

def provenance_repo(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "LICENSE").write_text("MIT root\n")
    (tmp_path / "LICENSE-up").write_text("MIT upstream\n")
    for s in ("a", "b"):
        (tmp_path / "skills" / s).mkdir(parents=True)
        (tmp_path / "skills" / s / "SKILL.md").write_text("---\nname: x\n---\n")
        (tmp_path / "skills" / s / "LICENSE").write_text("MIT root\n")
    (tmp_path / "skills" / "a" / "LICENSE-up").write_text("MIT upstream\n")
    return tmp_path, {"LICENSE-up": ("a",)}

    for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)):
        names = []
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            names = [a.name for a in node.names]
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0:
            names = [node.module]
        for n in names:
            top = n.split(".")[0]
            assert top in sys.stdlib_module_names or top in siblings, top

        if "check_provenance.py" in line:
